api_key.description: Supplied secret_* management key. Public upload/download keys and JWTs are separate auth families. Sent only as Bearer Authorization to api.bytescale.com; no exchange or renewal.
api_key.title: Secret API Key

account_id.description: Exact seven-character account ID from Bytescale settings. Resource visibility does not prove ownership.
account_id.title: Account ID

folder_paths.description: Explicit absolute folder roots this node may read. Descendants require current catalog/parent witnesses. Local subset excludes percent/backslash/dot/empty segments; no wildcard paths.
folder_paths.title: Allowed Folder Paths

folder_path.description: An allowed root or a currently cataloged descendant, at most four levels below a saved root. If omitted, use the first allowed root. File pickers require an explicitly selected parent.
folder_path.title: Folder

include_paths_and_names.description: Opt in to returned paths/original file names, which can contain private data. Types, sizes and MIME/virtual flags are returned by default.
include_paths_and_names.title: Include Names and Paths

file_path.description: Exact file path directly inside the selected folder; current list membership is required before details.
